Class GameTimerManager

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.controller.GameTimerManager
public class GameTimerManager extends Object
Manages all game timers including the level countdown timer and game loop timer. Provides centralized control for starting, stopping, pausing, and resuming timers.

    • startLevelTimer

      public void startLevelTimer(javafx.beans.property.IntegerProperty timeLeftProperty, Runnable onTimeExpired)
      Starts the level countdown timer. The timer decrements every second until it reaches zero.
      Parameters:
      timeLeftProperty - The property to bind and decrement
      onTimeExpired - Callback to execute when timer reaches zero

    • resetLevelTimer

      public void resetLevelTimer(int seconds)
      Resets the level timer to a specific number of seconds and restarts it.
      Parameters:
      seconds - Number of seconds to reset to

    • startGameLoop

      public void startGameLoop(int delayMs, Runnable onTick)
      Starts the game loop timer that triggers automatic brick drops.
      Parameters:
      delayMs - Delay in milliseconds between each drop
      onTick - Callback to execute on each timer tick

    • updateGameLoopSpeed

      public void updateGameLoopSpeed(int newDelayMs, Runnable onTick)
      Updates the game loop speed by changing the delay between ticks.
      Parameters:
      newDelayMs - New delay in milliseconds
      onTick - Callback to execute on each timer tick
